about_subtitle: Learn more about Mateen Online Store
about_intro: Mateen Online Store is Pakistan's trusted online shopping destination, offering quality products at the best prices.
about_story_text: Founded with a vision to make online shopping easy and reliable for every Pakistani household, Mateen Online Store has grown into a platform trusted by thousands of customers. We started with a simple idea — bring quality products to your doorstep at fair prices.
about_mission_text: To provide authentic products, fast delivery, and exceptional customer service across Pakistan — making online shopping simple, safe, and satisfying.
about_vision_text: To become Pakistan's most trusted and customer-friendly online store, known for quality, honesty, and innovation.
about_value_quality_desc: We only sell authentic, high-quality products.
about_value_trust_desc: Your satisfaction is our top priority.
about_value_support_desc: We're here to help whenever you need us.
about_cta_text: Explore thousands of products at unbeatable prices.
contact_subtitle: We'd love to hear from you
contact_intro: Have a question, feedback, or need help? Reach out to us — our team is always ready to assist.

faq_intro: Browse our most frequently asked questions below. Can't find what you're looking for? Contact our support team.
faq_q1: How do I place an order?
faq_a1: Browse products, add items to your cart, proceed to checkout, fill in your shipping details, and confirm your order.
faq_q2: What payment methods do you accept?
faq_a2: We accept Cash on Delivery (COD) and Bank Transfer. More payment options are coming soon.
faq_a3: Delivery usually takes 2–5 working days depending on your city. Remote areas may take slightly longer.
faq_a4: Delivery is free for orders above a certain amount. Otherwise, a small shipping fee applies at checkout.
faq_a5: Yes, you can return products within 7 days of delivery if they are damaged or incorrect. See our Return Policy for details.
faq_q6: How do I track my order?
faq_a6: Go to the 'Track Order' page and enter your order number, or view your orders from your account.
faq_q7: Do I need an account to shop?
faq_a7: You can browse without an account, but you'll need to sign up to place an order and track it.
faq_a8: Visit our Contact page, email us at support@mateenstore.com, or call +92 300 1234567.
faq_a9: Yes, we only sell 100% authentic and original products sourced from trusted suppliers.
faq_a10: Yes, you can cancel your order before it is shipped. Contact support as soon as possible.
terms_s1_text: By accessing or using Mateen Online Store, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.
terms_s2_text: You must provide accurate and complete information when creating an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials.
terms_s3_text: All orders are subject to acceptance and availability. Prices are displayed in PKR and may change without notice. Payment must be completed as per the selected method.
terms_s4_text: We aim to deliver all orders within the estimated timeframe. Delivery times may vary based on location and circumstances beyond our control.
terms_s5_text: Returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery for damaged or incorrect items. Refunds will be processed after inspection. See our Return Policy for details.
terms_s6_text: You agree not to misuse our platform, including fraudulent orders, abusive behavior, or any activity that violates applicable laws.
terms_s7_text: Mateen Online Store is not liable for indirect or incidental damages arising from the use of our services, beyond the value of the product purchased.
terms_s8_text: We reserve the right to update these terms at any time. Continued use of our services after changes means you accept the updated terms.
terms_s9_text: For questions about these terms, contact us at support@mateenstore.com.
privacy_subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your data
privacy_s1_text: We collect information you provide during registration and checkout, such as your name, email, phone number, and shipping address.
privacy_s2_text: Your information is used to process orders, provide customer support, improve our services, and send important updates.
privacy_s3_text: We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, remember your preferences, and analyze site traffic.
privacy_s4_text: We do not sell your personal data. Information may be shared with delivery partners and payment processors only to fulfill your order.
privacy_s5_text: We use industry-standard measures to protect your data. However, no online transmission is 100% secure.
privacy_s6_text: You have the right to access, update, or request deletion of your personal information by contacting us.
privacy_s7_text: Our services are not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children.
privacy_s8_text: For privacy-related questions, contact us at support@mateenstore.com.
return_intro: We want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. If you're not happy, we're here to help.
return_s1_text: Products can be returned within 7 days of delivery if they are damaged, defective, or different from what you ordered.
return_s2_text: Certain items such as perishables, personal care products, and clearance items cannot be returned for hygiene and safety reasons.
return_s3_text: Contact our support team with your order number and reason for return. We'll guide you through the process.
return_s4_text: Once we receive and inspect the returned item, refunds will be processed within 5–7 working days via the original payment method.
return_s5_text: If you'd prefer an exchange instead of a refund, we'll happily replace the item subject to availability.
return_s6_text: Return shipping is free for damaged or incorrect items. For other returns, shipping costs may apply.
return_s7_text: Reach out at support@mateenstore.com or call +92 300 1234567 to initiate a return.
about_who_text: Mateen Online Store is a modern e-commerce platform committed to providing high-quality products at affordable prices. We connect customers with a wide range of products, from electronics to fashion, all in one place.
about_contact_text: Have questions? Visit our Contact Page or email us at support@mateenstore.com
feature_shipping_text: Quick and reliable shipping to your doorstep.
feature_support_text: Always here to help you with your needs.
